implementation.targetScope: React motion div/span/button and custom roots, initial/animate targets, hidden/show variant inheritance and staggering, initial=false, useAnimation start/set/stop, CSS-variable bell colors and repeat/reset, stable refs/DOM, hydration and reduced motion. Direct React rendering over vmotion-dom; no upstream runtime.
implementation.remainingWork: Consumer release and actual VentiMath integration. Gestures, drag/layout projection, AnimatePresence, sequences, useAnimate, SVG-specific geometry and other unobserved Motion APIs are outside this subset.

caller.scope: 43 non-test files, 110 JSX roots in static source inventory; only motion and useAnimation from motion/react. Contest entries, calendar/list entrances, sidebar/directory transitions, repeated notification bell, Material polymorphic roots. Static counts do not establish route reachability or adoption.

changes: Independently written from public types/API observations and app-shaped black-box controls; no upstream runtime source copied.
Native React nodes preserve focus and identity across unrelated rerenders; animation specifications are snapshotted and unchanged specifications do not restart.
Variant ownership crosses ordinary wrappers and respects independent animation scopes. Mounted children participate without restarting the parent.
Owned animation work is stopped and element bindings released on unmount; stale completions are suppressed.
Dynamic reduced-motion configuration and user preference changes stop transform playback; initial=false and SSR hydration preserve initial markup.
